patterns.note: The site uses a full-bleed dark background with content sections framed by subtle horizontal lines and numbered labels, creating a minimalist, editorial feel.
A dramatic contrast in typography is used, featuring an extremely large, high-contrast serif font for hero and footer elements, paired with a small, clean sans-serif for body text and navigation.
The design relies on a stark, high-contrast palette of deep charcoal black, vibrant orange as a primary accent, and crisp white or light grey for text and subtle UI elements.

As the user scrolls, the initial large hero text ('Filippo Ruffini') undergoes a complex, pixel-fragmentation and dissolve animation, transforming into the large footer copyright text ('(C)2023'), while the main page content scrolls underneath this animating overlay.
Content sections are introduced with large, numbered labels (e.g., '01', '02') positioned prominently on the left, acting as visual anchors for the sparse content blocks.

technique_notes: The site employs a sophisticated scroll-triggered animation system, likely using GSAP and canvas, to create a full-screen text transformation effect. The hero text dynamically fragments and dissolves, revealing the footer text as the user scrolls, while the main page content scrolls independently beneath this animated layer.
Interactive elements like the cookie banner buttons feature subtle rounded corners and a soft hover state, providing a tactile contrast to the sharp typographic elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, high-contrast serif display text (~8x body) dominates the hero and footer, while body and navigation text are small, clean sans-serifs.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons, otherwise sharp corners throughout.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy and spacious, particularly in the hero and project list, creating a minimalist and focused presentation.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the full-screen, scroll-triggered text transformation where the designer's name in the hero dynamically fragments and dissolves into the copyright year in the footer, creating a highly memorable and interactive visual experience.
